text:
Lina M: Quick QA of the Compliance card UI. CS reported customers confuse 'KMS' badge with key state (on/off). Also region selector is buried under a long label. Screenshot attached.

Noah P: Can we split the badge into two parts: icon + short label 'KMS' and a small state chip 'cust' or 'redacted' ? That lets users scan key type vs state.

Rina (DevEx): Important: whatever we do must be keyboard focusable. Right now the badge is non-interactive. Proposed: <button class="kms-chip" aria-label="Customer-managed key settings">🔒 KMS</button>. Add aria-describedby to the row for the retention explanation.

Samir (Security): Audit log copy needs to be explicit. Current: "KMS changed" -> replace with "Encryption configuration updated: customer-managed key enabled by <user>". For rotations: "KMS key rotated by <user> (key id redacted)". Include tags: action=encryption.update,target=kms,method=ui.

Lina M: Good. Also region UX: can we show a small secondary line under project name: "Primary region: us-west-2" so users don't need to hunt in settings? That would reduce confusion.

Noah P: Agree. For mobile, enlarge region selector hit area to 48px and shorten displayed region to abbreviation (us-west-2 -> US-W). Tooltip on expand shows full name.

Rina (DevEx): Accessibility report: ux-bot found two issues: 1) KMS badge contrast 2.8:1 at 12px, 2) tooltip content not accessible via keyboard. I'll attach report. We should bump badge bg to accent-800 or text to text-0 and ensure tooltips open on focus.

ux-bot: Scan results uploaded: /reports/1810500000/kms-contrast.csv, /reports/1810500000/tooltips.csv. Recommended fixes: focusable badges, 12px min tooltip, color token swap.

Samir (Security): One more: don't claim customers' model outputs are encrypted unless backend confirms. Tooltip should read precisely: "Encrypts request logs and metadata (not model outputs)" if that's true. Add help link to docs for exact scope.

Lina M: Action items: Noah - mock chip + region teaser line; Rina - a11y updates (focusable badge + tooltip focus behavior); Samir - canonical audit strings and tags; I'll consolidate and call for another pass tomorrow.

Noah P: Will upload updated figma in ~1h.

Rina (DevEx): I'll prepare a checklist for frontend: tabindex on badge, aria-labels, tooltip keyboard support.

ux-bot: Reminder: schedule follow-up review in calendar if uploads complete.
